providers.name: Ordnance Survey
providers.authority: National mapping agency for Great Britain
providers.authentication: Project API key or OAuth 2 client credentials for supported APIs; not user-delegated OAuth
providers.caching_redistribution: Must be evaluated per product and entitlement; derived-data constraints may apply
providers.longevity: Strategic provider; active end-of-life and migration programme
providers.known_changes: NGD and product rationalisation require explicit version/EOL tracking
providers.quality_limitations: Scale, generalisation, update cadence and product semantics vary
providers.recommended_integration: Server-side adapter and credential broker; separate protected caches; preserve native identifiers and version metadata

providers.name: ONS Data API
providers.caching_redistribution: Respect dataset terms and API fair use; prefer frozen metadata and bulk data where appropriate
providers.longevity: Active but service evolution/retirement notices must be monitored
providers.known_changes: New ONS data platform and API evolution
providers.quality_limitations: Suppression, revisions, uncertainty and dimension semantics require preservation
providers.recommended_integration: OKF for discovery; live validation at execution; version-bound observation retrieval

providers.name: ONS Geography and Open Geography Portal
providers.authority: Official statistical geography authority for England and Wales, with UK products where published
providers.geographic_scope: England and Wales plus UK-wide products depending on dataset
providers.licence: Product-specific ONS/OS/Royal Mail rights; not all geography products have identical rights
providers.caching_redistribution: Record rights per product and vintage
providers.attribution: ONS and third-party source attribution where required
providers.longevity: Strategic but service and portal interfaces can change
providers.known_changes: Boundary vintages and code successors are continual
providers.quality_limitations: Generalisations, exact/ultra-generalised variants, UK nation differences and temporal code changes
providers.recommended_integration: Versioned boundary/code cache with temporal identifier graph and source-native fields

providers.name: Nomis
providers.authority: ONS labour market and census dissemination service
providers.authentication: Public; optional API credentials for higher limits
providers.licence: Dataset/source specific, usually OGL with attribution
providers.caching_redistribution: Respect API limits and dataset terms
providers.quality_limitations: Suppression, differing census vintages, code-list semantics and selection limits
providers.recommended_integration: Discovery through OKF; deterministic query builder; preserve exact dimension order and code lists

providers.name: LandIS
providers.authentication: Public for open-access portal; product-specific conditions may remain
providers.licence: Read and enforce each record licence; do not infer one blanket licence from “open access”
providers.caching_redistribution: A local open cache is justified only for explicitly licensed downloadable products and with provenance/scale caveats
providers.longevity: New open-access service launched in 2026; operational horizon should be monitored
providers.quality_limitations: Scale, survey date, uncertainty, interpretation and fitness-for-purpose warnings are essential
providers.recommended_integration: Harvest records into OKF and OGC Records crosswalk; cache only licence-confirmed products; expose uncertainty

providers.name: HM Land Registry open publications
providers.authority: Official land registration authority for England and Wales
identifiers: title number in products where lawfully published
providers.licence: OGL plus additional Royal Mail/OS conditions for some address fields
providers.caching_redistribution: Retain record-level rights and attribution; do not generalise all HMLR data as open
providers.quality_limitations: Price Paid Data is transactional, not proof of ownership or exact boundary; corrections/revisions occur
providers.recommended_integration: Use as public worked example with explicit legal/fitness warnings and rights metadata

providers.name: HM Land Registry protected and paid services
providers.authority: Official land registration authority for England and Wales
providers.licence: Contract, statutory fee and permitted-use specific
providers.caching_redistribution: No caching or redistribution beyond explicit contract and legal authority
providers.quality_limitations: Legal effect and official-copy rules require direct service use and human/legal controls
providers.recommended_integration: Metadata discovery only in first phases; no protected transaction implementation until legal, security and service agreements are complete
